I. INTRODUCTION

Fund is a shareholder of MPS, a fabless semiconductor company that designs and markets advanced analog and mixed-signal semiconductors.1 The Fund brought this suit on behalf of MPS against all seven members currently on the MPS board,2 as well as one former director3 and current or former senior officers of MPS.4 In 2010, MPS shareholders suffered a negative 31.17% annual shareholder return, while shareholders of its peer group of companies received, on average, a positive annual return of 24.99%.
